svg.text: One module rail supplies qualified SD and OLED loads. Short local 3.3 V accessory wiring only.
M1 RP2040-Zero module, original receptacle absent
The former VBUS lands still carry SYS5. Keep them inaccessible and insulated. J2 VBUS stays separate.
Only the native D+ and D- lands leave the module's connector footprint. Keep BOOTSEL and RESET accessible.
The module regulator rating alone does not establish
Fit J5 and J6 assemblies only after the actual module, card
and OLED pass the combined thermal and transient budget.
Direct GPIOs are for local 3.3 V accessories. Installation
DNP an unqualified accessory as a complete interface. An
unpowered accessory must not be driven through its GPIOs.
Qualified bare 3.3 V socket or equivalent. DAT1/DAT2 pull high. Use at most the qualified card
J6 OLED and J7/J8 local headers
Check J6 connector polarity and existing pull-ups. GP16 is the built-in pixel.
J7 and J8 are 3.3 V data and common ground only. Power off the peers for connection. No 5 V
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
